about.title: About Me
about.text: Game Development student specialized in programming, with a strong focus on C++ and Unreal Engine. I am particularly interested in gameplay systems, engine architecture, and performance optimization. I also work on music composition and sound design, as I believe audio plays a critical role in player experience. I enjoy understanding how systems work at a deep level, both technically and creatively. I love exploring all the possible ways to implement a function in order to determine the best option.
